strings.en: Well then, shall we begin?
Heh...
I shall be your opponent.
Your luck ran out when you stood before me.
This... is how you attack.
Trying to defy my master?/　You don't know your place!
Heh... That is how it is.
Okay, let's go all out and show off/　Granzon's cheat-tier power!
Chika.../　Where did you learn words like that?
Now, shall we have a bout?
Master, go all out!
Not running at the sight of the Granzon?/　You've got guts!
Everyone has their own circumstances.
Now then, let's go wild on the surface too!
We're in space, Chika.
Chika, we're inside a ship.
How unlucky for you, facing me and the Granzon.
No one, whoever they may be,/　can ever bind me.
How unlucky for you,/　facing me and the Neo Granzon.
Then allow me to show you/　the Neo Granzon's power.
The Fury... I shall face you myself.
That mobile weapon is no match for the Granzon.
A mobile weapon like that/　cannot stop this Granzon.
Let's scatter those guys quick!
Yes... Let's go.
Gadisword... I shall be your opponent.
Were you, too,/　drawn to Earth...?
Heh.../　Feel free to use Larseilam.
Even a Raftclans/　is no match for this Granzon.
Gomoudokka Golaikunru.../　Whatever your position may be,/　you will vanish here.
Granzon's power, refined by my own hand.../　Feel it firsthand.
If he's really Golaikunru's manager,/　he must be loaded!
...That is irrelevant.
However large malice entities grow,/　they are no match for the Granzon.
Even an Ida type is no enemy of mine.
I must erase you completely,/　so you cannot be reborn.
This isn't the first time/　I've fought a being like you.
That, too, is no mere coincidence...
Kadum Hakam.../　Your luck ran out when you appeared before me.
How unfortunate, Kadum Hakam./　You had to run into me here.
Fury.../　I'll have you learn the power/　of the Neo Granzon as well.
To appear before the Neo Granzon/　in a machine like that.../　How foolish.
A Raftclans/　is no match for the Neo Granzon.
Gomoudokka Golaikunru.../　This is the Neo Granzon.
Before this Neo Granzon,/　you are no more than an infant.
XN-L.../　To me now, you are no threat.
I shall sever that obsession of yours.
Jua-Mu... I shall deliver your final rites.
Let me see the power of a Fury knight.
Karo-Ran... Vanish into the darkness.
That machine does not deserve/　the name Emperor Unit.
The name Gu-Landon is way too easy/　to mix up with Granzon!
Shall we end this, Gu-Landon?
Granzon, Gu-Landon.../　They totally overlap!/　That's damage to our reputation!
...Either way,/　he'll be making his exit here.
Heh... I never thought/　I'd meet you again.
Showing yourself before me again.../　You have more nerve than I thought.
Allow me to offer you a proverb:/　grasp all, lose all.
Kinaha Sokonko... Your luck has run out.
You know how Quepalok Namo ended up,/　don't you?
The way that guy talks really ticks me off!
No, not particularly.
The Baran-Schneil, is it? I'll give you/　the same fate as Lord Zezenan.
You cannot stop me.
To think you'd block my path/　with machines like those...
You are no obstacle at all.
Now, I must hurry.
You seem to have some fight in you.../　but you cannot stop me.
You seem a capable soldier,/　but you lack the power to face me.
Now that I'm here,/　I won't allow any stalling.
Herluga.../　Reckless curiosity will be your undoing.
It's impossible for the likes of you/　to control the Cross Gate.
With your life,/　I shall bring this battle to a close.
Master, how much do you think/　the Cross Gate would sell for?
...Chika, be quiet.
Meet the same end as Dark Brain.
You shall vanish, just like your master.
Return to the darkness as well.
Seriously, that guy's name and face are a joke!
I can guess whose taste that was.
You should have been burned once already.
Golaikunru doesn't seem to learn.
Let me teach you my power once more.
Meddling in the Earth Sphere again,/　never learning... How foolish.
A barrage cannot stop the Granzon.
No need to narrow my aim.
Whatever the armor, I shall shatter it.
That level of malice/　is nothing to worry about.
Lamaris are/　of no consequence to me.
Vanish, Lamaris.
Growing a little larger won't...
A Lamaris is a Lamaris. No threat.
Having you there is a bit inconvenient.
I really must repay you for that.
This is your reward for defying me.
You're the one/　who made the first move... Heh heh heh.
Now, it's my turn.
I've seen through your tactics.
You should have just kept running...
Then I shall attack without restraint as well.
Time for you to pay the price.
Well then, let's return the favor.
Ngh... Well done...
It seems this is as far as I go...
Heh... Well done.
Ngh! Not bad...
...?! To go this far.../　It seems I underestimated you.
Mmh! This power.../　It exceeds my expectations.
Ngh... I see,/　so you're desperate as well.
Ngh... I see. A clever move.
Not bad./　But this isn't over yet.
Hm... That was a slight miscalculation.
Tch!!
M-Master, Master!!/　This is bad, this is bad,/　this is baaaaaad!
...Chika, be quiet.
Guh!? N-No, it can't be!?
Whaaat?! No way what, Master?!/　Hey!
To drive me this far...
M-M-M-Master!/　Even kappa fall from trees, right?!/　Right?!
Gyaaaaah!!/　I die, I dies, I dying, I'm gonna die!
...You're panicking too much, Chika./　And your grammar is odd./　Monica's influence, perhaps...
Buying time won't change the outcome.
Your idea itself is interesting, though.
You can't defeat me with the power of darkness.
I see.../　XN-L, I understand your power well now.
...Even if Dark Brain were revived,/　I would simply defeat it.
Tch!/　...But this much won't defeat me.
Hm... You'd fight me with only that?/　...Heh, how foolish...
Not bad.../　But the real contest starts now.
Tch!/　...But this much still isn't/　enough to defeat me.
Ngh... Finally, a decent attack.
Ngh... But,/　it's still nothing to speak of...
Oh... A fine attack./　But it lacks decisive force.
I see, so that's your approach./　Not a bad attack.
Hm, you've found a good opening./　Quite skillful.
Oh...? It seems I need to revise/　my opinion of you a bit.
That shook a little,/　but it's nothing.
That is what is called reckless.
Having targeted me,/　you won't get off lightly.
Ngh!? Not bad.
But Master's not gonna go down/　to something like that! No way, no how!/　Master is invincible, after all!
Oh... Surprisingly...
J-Just so you know!/　That was a total fluke!/　Once Master gets serious, it's nothing!
Oh? So you landed a direct hit.
It's not that we couldn't dodge it!/　We just chose not to!
Interesting... What a unique move.
Don't tell me... Bullseye or Pierce.../　No, that can't be!
That did some damage.../　Master, the Granzon won't get/　wrecked now, right?
Of course not.
Not bad./　But Master, there's no way the Neo Granzon/　could get wrecked now, right?
Naturally.
Targeting me for glory, are you?
That unit is a bit troublesome.
Its performance seems different/　from other Raftclans...
Don't get cocky, Granzon!
...You said that wrong on purpose, didn't you?
You will never return to your homeland.
I have no interest in you, Iradoya.
Shall we end this little sideshow?
Is that all, Vort Nikolaus?
A Raftclans cannot stop me.
...This is no mass-produced unit, it seems.
Granzon is not as fragile/　as you seem to think.
Not nearly enough. Is this all?
Do you honestly think you can/　defeat me with that?
Heh... Futile struggling...
You're no match for me.
You can't stop me, you know.
You think that's enough/　to defeat me?
...I'd thought you'd come at me/　with a better attack than that.../　I had higher hopes.
Heh... Unless you get a bit more serious,/　you'll shorten your life.
Heh... Well, I'll at least/　praise you for landing a hit.
How feeble.../　Challenging me with a thing like that...
...Is that the best you can do?/　Don't disappoint me.
Oh, it seems something touched me.
And? What will you do next?
Ah, you wanted my attention.
That won't work.
Didn't feel a thing, you pipsqueak!/　Go wash your face and come back/　the day before yesterday!
Not even worth dodging.
That wasn't a piloting mistake, okay?!/　Don't get the wrong idea!
You still have a long way to go.
If that's you going all out,/　that's a laugh!
Gu-Landon's attacks/　don't work on the Granzon!
Exactly.
What if we beat him/　and he turns into Neo Gu-Landon...
Chika, be quiet.
Is that all your obsession amounts to?
Is that all, Karo-Ran?
Kinaha... You know my power well, don't you?
You'd better get serious, Iradoya.
You chose the wrong machine, Gomoudokka.
Oh? I'd heard you were/　Gadisword's ace...
You're the one who'll/　be shedding blood, Reggiane.
It seems you're not fully drawing out/　the Cross Gate's power.
The power of darkness won't work on me.
Not as strong as Dark Brain./　Naturally, I suppose.
No surprises here, XN-L.
That's about all a Zovorg machine can do.
Not much to them,/　these Fury mobile weapons.
The Raftclans's mobility/　is quite something, but...
That level of malice...
Its size and power aren't proportional.
Only the outside has changed?
You won't hit me...
Heh... How foolish.
Your aim is sloppy.
Where are you aiming? I'm over here.
Please aim more carefully.
It's meaningless if you can't hit.
Oh my, is that all?
Even if it hits,/　it won't matter, but...
Betting it all on one attack/　is the height of folly.
There's no way that would hit.
Oh, were you aiming for me?
How unskilled...
I know, right?!/　Trying to defy Master with just that?/　Talk about not knowing your place!
Nyah, nyah, you stink!/　You clumsy, bumbling dum-dum!
...Be quiet, Chika.
Even if it hit, it wouldn't be a big deal!
Too slow.
Exaaactly!/　It's so boring I'm yawning,/　and a fly could land on it!
Even if it did hit,/　the Granzon wouldn't budge!
Speed isn't everything.
Is that all?
Heh... Just the attack I predicted.
How shallow...
Brave of you, targeting me.
No matter how many times you try,/　the result is the same.
Big and useless!/　A total dud!
For now, at least.
Heh heh heh... It's useless.
Something seems to be lacking.
Momentum alone won't be enough/　to defeat me, you know.
Well, that will do.
Heh heh heh... You've been spared.
Out of range from here...?/　Well, no matter.
Plinking from long range, what a cheapskate!/　You chicken!
...Unable to counter...?/　Oh well, it can't be helped.
Oh... So there was that approach.
You won't escape.
It isn't over yet.
Heh heh heh... We're only getting started.
Can you withstand this blow?
You may leave the rest to me.
It's too early to relax.
You may leave the rest to me.
Then allow me to join in.
I shall lend you my strength.
Heh... You were rather slow to notice me.
Yon, I'll provide support.
Masaki... You want me to clean up after you?
Masaki, leave the rest to me.
Let me help, Lüne.
Amala, fall back.
It can't be helped.
For the Granzon, this much is...
Very well, I shall protect you.
Stand back. I'll take over.
It can't be helped. I'll take this one.
I'll take charge of this situation.
Losing fighting strength/　is hardly desirable, after all.
Yon, withdraw.
Masaki, have you forgotten what I told you?
We can't afford to lose Cybuster, after all.
Lüne, stand back.
Amala, disengage.
Allow me to show you/　the power of Granzon.
Those who stand in my way.../　will be shown no mercy.
You have nerve, standing in my way.
Heh... The real hell begins now.
Too slow. Allow me to give you another.
Shall we try this again?
It seems you failed to escape.
Another turn?! Lucky, lucky!
Heh. Though it's unlucky for them.
Now, are you prepared?
Are you prepared?
How about this?
Accept your fate quietly.
Resistance is futile.
You're in the way.
Vanish.
Gran Beam, fire.
Granzon has weapons like this as well.
This should be more than enough for you.
Then let's use this weapon, shall we?
Here goes! Gran Beam, fiiire!
Gravitron Cannon, fire!
Grand Worm Sword.
Running is pointless.
This is... the end...!
Take this.
Worm Smasher!
Heh heh heh... How about this?
This weapon warps space and time, everything,/　and destroys it.
Distrion... Break!
The power of Granzon.../　Learn it firsthand.
Distrion Break!
Now then, shall we end this?
A converged micro black hole/　possesses a special solution.
A naked singularity/　eats away at space-time itself.
There is no escaping/　gravitational collapse!
Vanish beyond the event horizon...!
Black Hole Cluster, fire!
As you approach the event horizon,/　relative time slows down.
For you it may be but an instant,/　but for us it is an eternity.
Do you understand?
How unlike me. That was rather childish.
It was decided from the very start.
At this range, this will do.
Neo Gran Beam, fire.
Now, this is the finale.
Phase transition output, maximum.
Degeneracy pressure, increasing...
Gravitational collapse critical point, exceeded...
Regrettably, this is goodbye.
I shall erase your existence/　from this universe...!
Sleep.
Degeneration Cannon... fire!
